verdict.rationale: Okta's docs confirm SCIM-based CRUD provisioning (create/update/deactivate) across connected apps and event hooks for triggering downstream actions, which supports automated deprovisioning, but no evidence in the pack explicitly confirms that deactivating a user immediately terminates active sessions or that this happens as a single unified action across all connected apps. missing for 10: explicit documentation of session/token revocation on deactivation, evidence of a single 'deactivate' action cascading in real time across all connected SCIM apps, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this behavior.
